name: Shouldertap for iPhone
subtitle: Send a tap. Get an answer.
promotionalText: Send a short message to someone you know, see when it reaches their screen, and get an answer. Link your own iPhone to receive taps on the go.
description:
Tap someone on the shoulder from your iPhone.

Shouldertap is private, invite-only messaging for people who want a clear answer. Send a short tap to someone who has invited you from their Mac, see when it reaches their screen, and read their reply.

PAIR WITH PEOPLE YOU KNOW
Scan an invite QR code or paste an invite link. Choose your name and color, then send a tap. Only invited people can contact an inbox; there is no public feed or discovery.

CLOSE THE LOOP
Follow each tap from sent to on screen to answered. The recipient can reply On it, In 10 min, or with a few words. Answering on one linked device dismisses the tap across the inbox's connected devices.

RECEIVE TAPS ON YOUR IPHONE
Link your iPhone to your existing Mac inbox using its QR code or link code. See incoming taps in the app, on the Lock Screen or Dynamic Island as a Live Activity on supported devices, or as a notification when available. Answer from your iPhone or Mac.

KEEP YOUR PEOPLE TOGETHER
The Tap tab keeps the people you can message and their recent replies together. The Inbox tab shows received taps and lets you invite people and manage linked devices and senders.

YOU CONTROL YOUR CONNECTIONS
Unpair to stop sending, remove a sender to block their access to your inbox, unlink a device, or report a problem from Help and privacy. Sender pairings and their message history can be deleted from Help and privacy.

REQUIRES SHOULDERTAP FOR MAC
An inbox is set up using Shouldertap for Mac on macOS 14 or later and needs an active trial or unlocked inbox. The iPhone companion is free and requires an internet connection. Notification and Live Activity delivery depend on device support and system settings. Replies to taps you send update while the app is open; those replies do not trigger push notifications.

Explore a clearly labeled sample tap from Help and privacy before pairing. Shouldertap is intended for everyday communication, not emergencies.
